en: You're giving me the creeps...
Kindly stop following me.
Going home is so depressing.
I never feel at ease there.
Let's run off somewhere far away,
just the two of us...
Oh, listen to me.
Not really. I'm only joking.
As if I could ever do such a thing.
Is there something you want?
No, it's just that you're so very beautiful
that I had to say a word of greeting...
Aren't you out to wheedle your way in here
What a suspicious man...
I wonder what you're scheming.
Please, I'm begging you.
About my going out drinking,
please keep it a secret.
I always tell them I'm at society parties
or calling on other ladies.
I don't want the servants or anyone in this
house to know...
that I go out drinking every single day.
So you'll keep quiet. Thank you.
To ease my loneliness, did you come
all the way to my house?
Oh, listen to me... Of course not.
Being at home is so depressing...
There's no place for me here, after all.
A beautiful lady drinking all alone?
May I ask your name?
I am Janis...
"Beautiful"? That sort of transparent flattery
Why, what a pleasure to meet
you again in a place like this...
Janis, wasn't it?
Just leave me alone.
I want to drink by myself.
Maybe I did drink a bit too much after all.
I'd better sober up before I go home...
Oh? I know your face.
Who were you again...?
Oh, well. It doesn't matter.
Barman, another glass...
Haven't you had too much to drink?
Madam, you ought to cut back a little.
Hic. Wh-who do you think you are?
I don't need a stranger lecturing me too,
I'm sorry about the other day.
You'd only been worried about me,
after all.
Without my drink, I simply couldn't
go on living.
Many people believe wealth is a virtue,
but I don't think so.
My household is rich, yet I'm so lonely
and not the least bit happy.
How about hearing a drunk's tale today?
The family I married into, you see, is thriving
and very rich.
But with a nagging mother-in-law and servants,
it's a terribly uncomfortable house.
My husband's so busy with work he never
pays me any attention...
And so, every day, here I am,
drinking and carrying on.
So it's drink to ease the loneliness,
is that it?
Yes, perhaps I am lonely.
For the tears I shed alone, I replenish
the lost water with alcohol.
Do you want something from me, sonny?
No, um... I just wondered where
such a beautiful lady might be
going...
is quite unnecessary.
Flattery...? I'm sorry if I've
offended you. But I didn't mean it
that way.
Hee hee, what a sweet boy.
